Read a SAS table.description: Read a SAS table or view into a pandas DataFrame. Dataset options go in brackets after the name, for example sashelp.class(where=(age>13)). A missing table returns None.

Write a SAS table.description: Write a pandas DataFrame to a SAS table: work for this session, or a writable library to keep it.

Filter with PROC SQL, then read.description: Filter a large table on the SAS side with a PROC SQL view, then read only the view.

Read a macro variable.description: Read a SAS macro variable. The value is always a str, and "" when the variable does not exist.

Set a macro variable.description: Set a SAS macro variable. The value is stored as text: 42 reads back as "42".

body: raise RuntimeError("SAS step failed: SYSERR=" + syserr)
Run SAS code and check it.description: Run SAS code, and stop if its last step failed. SAS.submit returns 0 even when a step fails; SYSERR is the last step's code, 0 for success and 4 for a warning.

Show a figure.description: Draw a matplotlib figure and show it in the Result panel, as PNG.

Show a DataFrame.description: Show a pandas DataFrame as a table in the Result panel.

Write a warning to the SAS log.description: Write a WARNING line to the SAS log, shown in the output. A message at the default NOTE level is not shown.

Upload a DataFrame to CAS.description: Upload a pandas DataFrame to a CAS table. Needs conn from Insert CAS Connection Snippet. The table lasts as long as conn's CAS session.

Read a CAS table.description: Read a whole CAS table into a DataFrame. Needs conn from Insert CAS Connection Snippet.

Assign a library without a password lite.description: Assign a database library with a password taken at run time, never written in the code. %superq keeps the password out of the SAS log.
